description: Request bodies: no body, malformed JSON (the reference's status-less Error: 500), JSON null (TypeError reading a property: 500), numbers and arrays as bodies, a password that is not a string (Node's ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE from scrypt: 500), bytes that are not UTF-8, any content type, and a body over the login limit.

steps.name: setup with bytes that are not UTF-8

allow.reason: Deliberate fix: request bodies are limited (64 KiB on login, setup, users and connections). The reference buffered any size before authentication; the Rust server answers 413.
Same body-limit fix: the reference's 401 envelope against the Rust 413 envelope.
